Baidu's second-quarter revenue fell 4% year over year while AI Cloud Infra revenue grew 50%. A/H trading should test Baidu's negative feedback against domestic compute and energy hedges.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
美伊无新谈判安排，霍尔木兹通行仍受条件约束
美联社8月18日报道，美国称暂无对伊谈判安排，伊朗则坚持在美方满足解除封锁、油运制裁等条件前不全面重开霍尔木兹海峡。外交缓和仍可能出现，但油价与航运风险溢价短期难消。
国际
海峡船只遇袭与沙特炼厂威胁抬升能源尾险
美联社称一艘船在海峡附近被不明投射物击中并出现人员伤亡，胡塞武装另称袭击沙特炼厂；Kpler数据显示上周海峡确认通行量下降19.5%。事实偏利多上游能源与油服，利空航空、化工和高估值成长。
科技
隔夜AI芯片链领跌，存储成为最弱映射
美联社确认Micron下跌7.0%、Nvidia下跌2.3%、Broadcom下跌3.2%，纳指跌1.3%。Sparks实时排行抓取失败，公开行情压力样本仍显示存储、GPU与ASIC同步去估值；A/H映射先看兆易创新、海光信息、中芯国际能否低开后缩量止跌。
科技
高利率继续压缩AI基础设施估值容忍度
美国10年期国债收益率从周一4.72%小幅回落至4.70%，但仍显著高于伊朗战争前的3.97%；30年期收益率接近2007年以来高位。融资成本偏高会提高数据中心资本开支的回报门槛，CPO、服务器、电源液冷需用订单与成交验证。
科技
Meta下跌4.4%，平台监管尾险压制互联网估值
Meta在加州社交媒体伤害诉讼开庭陈词期间下跌4.4%。该事件不是中国平台公司的同类基本面冲击，但会压低全球平台估值风险偏好；腾讯、阿里和美团需靠本地业绩与成交抵消外部折价。
科技
Keysight盘后上涨约5%，测试设备提供局部正映射
公开盘后行情显示Keysight在营收受AI数据中心需求推动、指引高于预期后上涨约5%。这是AI测试测量的局部正反馈，不能抵消美股芯片普跌；A/H更适合作为通信测试、光模块和设备链的承接验证，而非全面追涨信号。
财报
百度二季度营收和利润承压，AI云高增长未能完全对冲
百度官方披露二季度营收313亿元，同比下降4%；归母净利23亿元，非GAAP归母净利26亿元，非GAAP每ADS收益7.22元。AI Cloud Infra收入73亿元、同比增长50%，GPU Cloud增长283%；公开盘前行情一度跌约9%，说明传统广告下滑与盈利落差压过AI亮点，9888.HK应列风险观察而非直接做多。
财报
中通快递结果尚未从官方页面获得可验证数字
中通快递官方投资者页面确认二季度及半年业绩安排在8月18日美股收盘后发布，但截至抓取时官方新闻列表仍只显示发布日程，未取得可核验的收入、EPS与价格反馈。2057.HK今日只作事件观察，不用未核验数字补位。
财报
港交所今日披露中期业绩，金融权重等待本地验证
公开业绩日历显示港交所00388.HK于8月19日披露截至6月底的中期业绩。盘前尚无结果，重点观察成交活跃度、IPO收入、成本与分红；结果和价格反馈未出现前，不把预期写成事实。

盘前结论

事实层面，标普500、道指和纳指隔夜分别下跌0.7%、0.2%和1.3%，Micron、Nvidia、Broadcom与Meta同步承压，高利率和AI估值兑现构成A/H科技开盘逆风。同时，百度AI云基础设施收入增长50%、GPU Cloud增长283%，Keysight盘后约涨5%，说明AI需求没有消失，而是从普涨切换到订单、盈利和估值筛选。

判断上，A股可能低开后分化，国产算力、通信测试与能源防御先看承接；港股恒生科技重点看百度9888.HK是否把盘前负反馈消化在开盘，以及腾讯、阿里能否相对抗跌。

不确定性来自Sparks与Futu子项受限、中东谈判反复和盘前行情变化；若芯片龙头低开后放量止跌，可逐步提高成长权重，若油价继续上行且科技缩量，则维持能源对冲并回避高估值追涨。

利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

百度集团
9888.HK
业绩风险观察

推荐理由：AI云基础设施增长50%和GPU Cloud增长283%具备长期转型价值，但总营收与利润承压。

触发因素：若9888.HK低开后回补大部分跌幅，并出现南向资金和恒生科技同步承接，才考虑从观察转为交易。

风险点：公开盘前行情一度跌约9%，传统广告下滑与盈利落差意味着利好AI数据暂未获得价格确认。

海光信息
688041.SH
国产算力验证

推荐理由：国产算力逻辑可部分隔离海外供应链风险，是AI芯片回撤中的相对强弱观察标的。

触发因素：低开后放量收复开盘缺口，且科创芯片指数同步止跌。

风险点：Nvidia、Micron与Broadcom同步下跌说明行业估值收缩可能压过国产替代叙事。

中际旭创
300308.SZ
CPO承接

推荐理由：Keysight盘后正反馈说明AI测试和数据中心需求仍在，CPO是A股最直接的资本开支映射。

触发因素：海外光通信样本企稳，中际成交额放大且不破前低。

风险点：高利率会提高数据中心回报门槛，若AI硬件继续去估值，光模块难以独立走强。

中国海洋石油
0883.HK
能源对冲

推荐理由：海峡通行下降、船只遇袭与布伦特91美元附近为上游现金流提供防御支撑。

触发因素：亚洲盘油价维持强势且0883.HK高开后成交承接。

风险点：伊朗与阿曼若达成可执行通行协议，风险溢价可能快速回吐。

腾讯控股
0700.HK
平台韧性

推荐理由：百度和Meta均受压力时，腾讯的本地盈利质量与游戏现金流可提供相对防御。

触发因素：0700.HK相对恒生科技抗跌，并带动阿里、美团等平台权重缩小跌幅。

风险点：全球平台估值折价、AI投入和消费需求疲弱仍可能压制估值修复。

板块轮动看板

受益方向上游能源与油服、国产算力相对强弱、AI测试测量，以及有现金流支撑的平台龙头。
观察方向CPO光通信、服务器电源液冷、百度AI云、港交所业绩窗口与中通快递事件反馈。
压力方向存储芯片、GPU与ASIC高估值链、平台监管敏感方向及其他长久期成长。
验证信号9888.HK开盘反馈、科创芯片和CPO成交、布伦特91美元附近、恒生科技相对恒指表现。

逻辑链

霍尔木兹通行受限与布伦特维持91美元附近，使美债收益率保持高位并压低高估值成长的容忍度。
隔夜纳指跌1.3%，Micron、Nvidia与Broadcom领跌，先映射A/H存储、GPU和ASIC链的开盘压力。
百度总营收和利润承压但AI云高增长，说明AI需求仍在，资金会从主题普涨转向盈利与订单筛选。
Keysight盘后正反馈映射通信测试与CPO的局部承接，能源风险映射中海油的防御价值。
若9888.HK和芯片龙头低开后放量止跌，科技可修复；若油价上冲而科技缩量，轮动将偏向能源与低估值防御。

风险雷达

AI估值收缩

Micron、Nvidia与Broadcom同步回撤，可能扩散到A/H高估值硬件。

百度负反馈

AI云高增长未抵消总营收与利润压力，9888.HK可能承接ADR跌幅。

中东升级

海峡船只遇袭或炼厂受扰会推高油价、通胀和航运成本。

高利率资本开支

高美债收益率会抬升数据中心融资成本并延长回报周期。

数据源降级

Sparks与Futu子检查未取得完整结果，panel为公开行情样本而非完整板块排行。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP关于2026年8月18日美股收盘、AI芯片、美债、布伦特原油及中东局势报道；百度2026年二季度官方业绩公告；中通快递官方投资者页面与公开业绩日历；Keysight及其他公开盘后行情样本。抓取截止2026-08-19 08:55 CST。Futunn页面内部错误、Moomoo返回403；Futu HK/SH/SZ财报日历与NOTICE搜索因日志目录Operation not permitted未返回，均按规则降级。Sparks panel使用公开行情正负样本，不代表完整板块排行。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Global
No new US-Iran talks planned as Hormuz access remains conditional
AP reported on Aug. 18 that the United States has no new talks planned with Iran, while Tehran says it will not fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz until conditions including lifting the blockade and oil sanctions are met. Diplomacy remains possible, but oil and shipping risk premia are unlikely to disappear quickly.
Global
Ship strike and Saudi refinery threat lift the energy tail risk
AP said an unidentified projectile hit a ship near the strait and caused a crew casualty, while the Houthis claimed an attack on a Saudi refinery. Kpler data showed confirmed strait transits fell 19.5% last week. The fact pattern favors upstream energy and oil services while hurting airlines, chemicals and high-duration growth.
Tech
AI chips led the overnight decline, with memory the weakest link
AP confirmed Micron fell 7.0%, Nvidia 2.3% and Broadcom 3.2% as the Nasdaq lost 1.3%. Live Sparks rankings were unavailable, but verified public pressure samples still show simultaneous de-rating in memory, GPUs and ASICs. A/H confirmation should come from GigaDevice, Hygon and SMIC stabilizing after a weaker open.
Tech
High rates keep compressing tolerance for AI-infrastructure valuations
The 10-year Treasury yield eased to 4.70% from 4.72% Monday but remains far above the 3.97% level before the Iran war; the 30-year yield is near its highest since 2007. Elevated funding costs raise the hurdle rate for data-center capex, so CPO, servers, power and cooling need order and volume confirmation.
Tech
Meta fell 4.4% as regulatory tail risk weighed on platforms
Meta fell 4.4% as opening statements began in a California social-media harms trial. The event is not a like-for-like fundamental shock for Chinese platforms, but it can lower global platform valuation appetite; Tencent, Alibaba and Meituan need local earnings and trading support to offset that discount.
Tech
Keysight gained about 5% after hours, offering a narrow test-equipment offset
Public after-hours tape showed Keysight up about 5% after AI data-center demand supported revenue and guidance exceeded expectations. This is a narrow positive for test and measurement, not enough to offset the broader chip selloff; in A/H it is a support test for communications testing, optics and equipment rather than a broad chase signal.
Earnings
Baidu's Q2 revenue and profit weakened despite strong AI-cloud growth
Baidu reported Q2 revenue of RMB31.3 billion, down 4% year over year; attributable net income was RMB2.3 billion, non-GAAP attributable net income RMB2.6 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS RMB7.22 per ADS. AI Cloud Infra revenue rose 50% to RMB7.3 billion and GPU Cloud grew 283%, but public premarket tape showed shares down about 9%, meaning advertising weakness and the earnings gap outweighed the AI upside; 9888.HK is a risk watch, not an automatic long.
Earnings
ZTO results were not yet verifiable from the official page
ZTO's official investor page confirmed Q2 and half-year results were scheduled after the US close on Aug. 18, but at the retrieval cutoff its news list still showed only the release schedule, with no verifiable revenue, EPS or price reaction. Treat 2057.HK as an event watch and do not fill the gap with unverified numbers.
Earnings
HKEX reports interim results today, leaving a local test for financials
Public earnings calendars show HKEX, 00388.HK, is due to report interim results for the six months through June on Aug. 19. No result was available before the open; trading activity, IPO revenue, costs and the dividend are the key checks, and expectations should not be presented as facts before the release and price response.

Pre-open Conclusion

On the facts, the S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq fell 0.7%, 0.2% and 1.3% overnight, while Micron, Nvidia, Broadcom and Meta all weakened; high rates and AI multiple compression are headwinds for the A/H technology open.At the same time, Baidu AI Cloud Infra grew 50%, GPU Cloud grew 283%, and Keysight gained about 5% after hours, showing AI demand has not disappeared but has shifted from broad momentum to orders, earnings and valuation selection.

Our base case is a softer, split A-share open, with domestic compute, communications testing and energy hedges tested first; in Hong Kong, the main question is whether 9888.HK absorbs Baidu ADR weakness at the open and whether Tencent and Alibaba hold up relatively well.

Uncertainty comes from unavailable Sparks and Futu sub-checks, volatile Middle East diplomacy and changing premarket prices; if chip leaders stabilize on volume, growth exposure can be rebuilt gradually, but if oil rises further while technology trades thinly, maintain energy hedges and avoid chasing high multiples.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 show heat/importance, not percentage moves.

Key Stock Ideas

Baidu
9888.HK
Earnings risk watch

Reason: AI Cloud Infra growth of 50% and GPU Cloud growth of 283% support the long-term transition, but total revenue and profit weakened.

Trigger: Only consider moving from watch to trade if 9888.HK recovers most of a weak open with southbound and Hang Seng Tech support.

Risk: Public premarket tape showed a drop of about 9%; ad weakness and the earnings gap mean the AI upside lacks price confirmation.

Hygon Information
688041.SH
Domestic compute test

Reason: Domestic compute can partly isolate overseas supply-chain risk, making Hygon a relative-strength test during the AI-chip pullback.

Trigger: A volume-backed recovery of the opening gap with the STAR Chip Index stabilizing.

Risk: Synchronized declines in Nvidia, Micron and Broadcom show sector multiple compression can overwhelm the localization narrative.

Zhongji Innolight
300308.SZ
CPO support

Reason: Keysight's positive after-hours response shows AI testing and data-center demand remain intact, while CPO is a direct A-share capex read-through.

Trigger: Overseas optical names stabilize and Zhongji volume expands without breaking its prior low.

Risk: High rates raise data-center hurdle rates; optical modules may not decouple if AI hardware continues to de-rate.

CNOOC
0883.HK
Energy hedge

Reason: Lower strait traffic, a ship strike and Brent near $91 support upstream cash flow and defensive value.

Trigger: Oil stays firm in Asia and 0883.HK holds a stronger open on volume.

Risk: An enforceable Iran-Oman passage deal could unwind the risk premium quickly.

Tencent
0700.HK
Platform resilience

Reason: With Baidu and Meta under pressure, Tencent's local earnings quality and gaming cash flow can offer relative defense.

Trigger: 0700.HK outperforms Hang Seng Tech and helps Alibaba and Meituan narrow losses.

Risk: A global platform discount, AI spending and weak consumption can still cap valuation recovery.

Sector Rotation Board

BeneficiariesUpstream energy and oil services, relative strength in domestic compute, AI test and measurement, and cash-generative platform leaders.
WatchCPO optics, server power and cooling, Baidu AI Cloud, the HKEX earnings window and ZTO event feedback.
PressureMemory, high-multiple GPU and ASIC chains, regulation-sensitive platforms and other long-duration growth.
Confirmation9888.HK's opening response, STAR Chip and CPO volume, Brent near $91 and Hang Seng Tech performance versus the Hang Seng Index.

Logic Chain

Restricted Hormuz traffic and Brent near $91 keep Treasury yields elevated and reduce tolerance for expensive growth.
The Nasdaq fell 1.3% as Micron, Nvidia and Broadcom led losses, creating opening pressure for A/H memory, GPU and ASIC chains.
Baidu's weaker total revenue and profit but fast AI-cloud growth show AI demand remains, while flows shift from themes to earnings and orders.
Keysight's positive after-hours response maps to narrow support in testing and CPO, while energy risk maps to defensive value in CNOOC.
If 9888.HK and chip leaders stabilize on volume after a weak open, technology can repair; if oil rises while tech volume fades, rotation should favor energy and low-multiple defense.

Risk Radar

AI multiple compression

Synchronized declines in Micron, Nvidia and Broadcom can spread to expensive A/H hardware.

Baidu negative feedback

Fast AI-cloud growth did not offset total revenue and profit pressure, and 9888.HK may absorb ADR weakness.

Middle East escalation

Further ship or refinery attacks would raise oil, inflation and shipping costs.

High-rate capex risk

High Treasury yields raise data-center funding costs and lengthen payback periods.

Source degradation

Sparks and Futu sub-checks were unavailable, so the panel uses public market samples rather than a complete sector ranking.

Sources and Timestamp

Sources: AP coverage of the Aug. 18, 2026 US close, AI chips, Treasuries, Brent crude and Middle East developments; Baidu's official Q2 2026 release; ZTO's official investor page and public earnings calendars; Keysight and other public after-hours market samples. Retrieval cutoff: 2026-08-19 08:55 CST. Futunn returned an internal error, Moomoo returned 403, and Futu HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar and NOTICE checks failed with Operation not permitted on the log directory; all were degraded under the rules. The Sparks panel uses public positive and negative samples and is not a complete sector ranking.

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
期指
美股期指近乎平开，纳指继续落后
AP盘前数据显示，标普500期指近乎持平，道指期指涨0.1%，纳指期指跌0.1%；指数表面稳定，但成长股内部风险偏好仍弱。
AI
AI权重周二再遭集中抛售
周二标普500跌0.7%、纳指跌1.3%、道指跌0.2%；Micron跌7.0%、NVIDIA跌2.3%、Broadcom跌3.2%，显示高估值AI链仍在去杠杆。
盘前
Oracle、Marvell、Intel和Micron延续弱反馈
周三盘前Oracle跌逾1%，Marvell与Intel均跌近2%，Micron再跌约1%；利好叙事未能抵消估值与利率压力，暂不作多头推荐。
原油
霍尔木兹僵局推动布油升至约91.91美元
布伦特原油早盘涨约1%，WTI涨1.1%至约84.99美元；航运通道问题未解，能源通胀尾险继续压制长久期资产。
利率
10年期美债收益率约4.70%，仍处高位
10年期收益率由4.72%略回落至4.70%，但远高于伊朗冲突前约3.97%的水平；高融资成本继续约束AI数据中心资本开支估值。
联储
FOMC会议纪要成为盘中方向变量
美联储将在周三稍晚公布最近一次议息会议纪要；市场将寻找对通胀黏性、油价冲击与政策路径的线索。
贸易
美国推迟对约200亿美元加拿大进口商品加征关税
关税延后缓解部分北美贸易尾险，但持续谈判意味着工业、汽车与消费链的政策折价尚未完全消失。
零售
Target业绩改善但盘前仍跌约1.6%
Target连续第二季实现可比销售增长并上调展望，盘前股价却下跌约1.6%；价格反馈显示市场仍质疑利润质量与执行持续性。
医药科技
MRNA/MRK三期癌症疫苗事件引爆盘前交易
Moderna与Merck称个性化mRNA癌症疫苗联合Keytruda在高风险黑色素瘤三期试验达到关键终点；公开盘前信息显示MRNA一度涨约83%-100%、MRK约涨8%，MRNA只作高波动事件观察。
财报
ADI与EL财报形成少数正反馈
Analog Devices公布约40.2亿美元创纪录季度收入并给出偏强下一季指引，盘前走高；Estée Lauder业绩超预期、盘前涨逾8%，与AI权重弱势形成鲜明分化。

盘前结论

ADI、MRK与EL的事件和财报正反馈说明资金并未全面离场，而是更强调可验证催化。但纳指期指落后、AI权重延续抛售，布油约91.91美元与10年期收益率约4.70%共同压制高久期估值。

Oracle、Marvell、Intel、Micron和Target均出现负价格反馈，不纳入多头推荐；MRNA极端跳空只作高波动观察并回避追多。开盘更可能是指数平、内部强分化，财报兑现、医药事件与能源现金流相对占优。

若ADI/MRK/EL守住缺口且10Y不再上行，选择性多头可延续；若FOMC纪要更鹰、油价继续上冲或跳空股回吐，则提高现金与防御权重。

重点个股推荐

Analog Devices
ADI
财报正反馈

推荐理由：季度收入约40.2亿美元创纪录并高于预期，下一季指引偏强，盘前股价上行且财报相关交易活跃；相对半导体板块明显抗跌。

触发因素：开盘后守住财报缺口、成交继续放大且相对SMH维持强势，可确认从AI高估值向盈利兑现芯片的轮动。

风险点：半导体系统性抛售若扩散，或电话会暴露订单前置与毛利压力，正反馈可能快速收窄。

Merck
MRK
事件驱动强势

推荐理由：与Moderna合作的个性化癌症疫苗三期试验达到关键终点，MRK盘前约涨8%，相对大盘和医药板块均显著强势，事件成交活跃。

触发因素：若开盘后守住主要跳空区间且后续安全性、监管路径与商业化细节获得确认，可延续事件驱动。

风险点：三期成功不等于立即获批，统计细节、监管沟通与利润分成仍可能导致估值回吐。

Estée Lauder
EL
财报修复

推荐理由：收入与调整后EPS超预期并改善利润率展望，盘前涨逾8%、财报交易活跃，价格反馈明显优于Target与多数消费股。

触发因素：若开盘后守住缺口并由量能确认，同时管理层维持品牌修复与利润率路径，可继续作为消费修复样本。

风险点：年内跌幅仍大、重组成本和需求复苏持续性待验证；高开后不宜追价。

Moderna
MRNA
高波动观察

推荐理由：不作追涨型多头推荐；三期癌症疫苗关键终点带来盘前约83%-100%的极端正反馈与事件成交，仅保留为临床突破观察样本。

触发因素：只有在开盘后大幅换手、波动收敛并守住稳定价格区间，且完整临床数据支持新闻标题时，才重新评估。

风险点：单一事件驱动、跳空过大、统计与监管细节未完全消化；明确回避追多并等待止稳。

板块轮动看板

强势观察医药创新（MRK/MRNA事件）、模拟芯片财报兑现（ADI）、美妆修复（EL）与油价支撑的能源现金流。
事件驱动FOMC会议纪要、霍尔木兹航运进展、MRK/MRNA三期数据细节，以及今晚BILL、BULL、WOLF财报。
压力方向AI高估值硬件与存储；Oracle、Marvell、Intel、Micron盘前承压，Target改善基本面也未获正价格反馈。
验证信号10Y能否守住4.70%下方、布油是否继续上冲、ADI/MRK/EL能否守住跳空，以及MRNA是否出现剧烈获利回吐。

逻辑链

AI权重连续下跌叠加10Y约4.70%，说明估值压缩而非单一公司消息仍是科技主导变量。
布油约91.91美元强化通胀与高利率约束，利好能源现金流，却进一步压制长久期成长股。
ADI、MRK与EL凭财报或临床数据获得正反馈，资金从广泛AI暴露转向结果可验证的事件资产。
若FOMC纪要不更鹰、油价不再上冲且正反馈股守住缺口，内部轮动可支撑指数；反之纳指可能继续落后。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下是基于已知一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引、卖方修正和行业景气的主观概率判断，不是确定事实；已用公司IR核对披露时间，并排除已披露或日期错误的样本。

高概率 · BILL Holdings (BILL) · 65%公司确认8月19日盘后披露；一致预期约为调整后EPS 0.70-0.72美元、收入约4.30亿美元。过去四季EPS均超过预期、近三季收入也高于预期，支持较高概率；风险是中小企业需求、支付量与下一财年指引。
中概率 · Webull (BULL) · 45%公司新闻稿确认8月19日盘后披露；市场预期EPS约0.03-0.05美元、收入约1.75-1.87亿美元。交易活跃度有利，但最近一季EPS与收入均低于预期、近三次仅一次beat，因此只给中性偏低判断。
低概率 · Wolfspeed (WOLF) · 35%公司确认8月19日17:00 ET召开业绩会；市场预计EPS约-2.45美元，收入预期分歧约1.50-2.25亿美元。上季盈利surprise改善，但负毛利、利用率、现金流和指引不确定性较高，beat判断偏低。

风险雷达

油价与霍尔木兹升级

布油已约91.91美元，若航运风险再度升级，将推高通胀预期和长端利率并压制科技估值。

AI抛售继续扩散

Micron、NVIDIA、Broadcom周二大跌，Oracle、Marvell、Intel与Micron周三盘前仍弱，去杠杆可能跨板块延续。

MRNA极端跳空回吐

MRNA盘前一度上涨约83%-100%，主要来自单一临床事件；只作高波动观察，回避追多并等待数据细节与价格稳定。

FOMC纪要改变利率路径

若纪要比市场预期更鹰，10Y可能重返上行，当前财报与事件股的独立强势也会承压。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP关于2026-08-18收盘、2026-08-19期指、个股、原油、美债、汇率、Target与关税；Analog Devices、BILL、Wolfspeed、Cisco、Keysight、Zoom公司IR；Webull公司新闻稿；Kiplinger、Barchart、Futu、FXEmpire与公开盘前新闻流关于日历、预期、历史surprise和价格反馈。抓取时间：2026-08-19 21:06 CST。个别盘前成交量无统一精确文本时不虚构数值，并以价格方向、相对板块强弱与事件活跃度降级判断。

Major News Roundup
Futures
US futures hover near flat while Nasdaq still lags
AP data showed S&P 500 futures little changed, Dow futures up 0.1%, and Nasdaq futures down 0.1%. The surface is calm, but internal risk appetite for growth shares remains weak.
AI
AI leaders faced another concentrated selloff Tuesday
The S&P 500 fell 0.7%, Nasdaq 1.3%, and Dow 0.2% Tuesday. Micron lost 7.0%, NVIDIA 2.3%, and Broadcom 3.2%, showing that deleveraging remains active across high-multiple AI.
Premarket
Oracle, Marvell, Intel and Micron extend negative feedback
Oracle slipped more than 1% Wednesday premarket, Marvell and Intel nearly 2% each, and Micron about 1%. Narrative support has not offset valuation and rate pressure, so none qualifies as a bullish pick.
Oil
Unresolved Hormuz tension lifts Brent to about $91.91
Brent rose about 1% and WTI gained 1.1% to roughly $84.99. With the shipping route unresolved, the inflation tail risk continues to weigh on long-duration assets.
Rates
The 10-year Treasury yield remains elevated near 4.70%
The 10-year yield eased to 4.70% from 4.72%, but remains far above roughly 3.97% before the Iran conflict. High financing costs continue to constrain AI data-center capex valuations.
Fed
FOMC minutes are the key intraday direction variable
The Federal Reserve releases minutes from its latest policy meeting later Wednesday. Markets will look for clues on sticky inflation, the oil shock and the policy path.
Trade
US delays tariffs on about $20 billion of Canadian imports
The delay reduces part of the North American trade tail risk, but continuing negotiations leave a policy discount on industrial, auto and consumer supply chains.
Retail
Target improves results but still falls about 1.6% premarket
Target posted a second straight quarter of comparable-sales growth and raised its outlook, yet shares fell about 1.6% premarket. The reaction shows investors still question earnings quality and execution durability.
Medtech
MRNA/MRK Phase 3 cancer-vaccine news ignites premarket trading
Moderna and Merck said their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine with Keytruda met key endpoints in a Phase 3 high-risk melanoma study. Public premarket feeds showed MRNA up roughly 83%-100% at one point and MRK about 8%; MRNA is only a high-volatility event watch.
Earnings
ADI and EL provide rare positive earnings feedback
Analog Devices reported record quarterly revenue of about $4.02 billion and an upbeat next-quarter outlook, sending shares higher premarket. Estée Lauder beat expectations and rose more than 8%, sharply diverging from weak AI leaders.

Premarket Conclusion

Positive reactions in ADI, MRK and EL show that capital has not left entirely; it is demanding verifiable catalysts.But Nasdaq futures lag, AI leaders remain under pressure, and Brent near $91.91 plus the 10-year yield near 4.70% constrain long-duration valuations.

Oracle, Marvell, Intel, Micron and Target show negative feedback and are excluded from bullish picks; MRNA's extreme gap is only a high-volatility watch and not a chase.The opening setup is a flat index with sharp internal dispersion favoring delivered earnings, medical events and energy cash flow.

Selective longs can persist if ADI/MRK/EL hold their gaps and the 10-year stops rising; if the minutes are more hawkish, oil extends higher or gap names reverse, favor cash and defense.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 show heat/importance, not percentage moves.

Stocks to Watch

Analog Devices
ADI
Positive earnings reaction

Why it stands out: Quarterly revenue of about $4.02 billion set a record and beat expectations, next-quarter guidance was upbeat, and the shares rose in active earnings-related premarket trading, clearly outperforming semiconductors.

Trigger: Holding the earnings gap on expanding volume while maintaining relative strength versus SMH would confirm rotation from expensive AI exposure toward delivered chip earnings.

Risk: A systemic semiconductor selloff or call commentary exposing order pull-forwards and margin pressure could quickly narrow the positive reaction.

Merck
MRK
Strong event catalyst

Why it stands out: The personalized cancer vaccine developed with Moderna met key Phase 3 endpoints. MRK rose about 8% premarket, strongly outperforming the market and health care in active event trading.

Trigger: Holding the main gap while safety, regulatory-path and commercialization details are confirmed could extend the event-driven move.

Risk: Phase 3 success does not equal immediate approval; statistical detail, regulatory talks and profit sharing can still drive a valuation reversal.

Estée Lauder
EL
Earnings recovery

Why it stands out: Revenue and adjusted EPS beat while the margin outlook improved. Shares rose more than 8% in active earnings trading, much stronger than Target and most consumer names.

Trigger: Holding the gap on confirming volume while management sustains the brand-recovery and margin path would validate it as a consumer-turnaround leader.

Risk: The stock remains down for the year, while restructuring costs and demand durability need proof. Avoid chasing a large opening gap.

Moderna
MRNA
High-volatility watch

Why it stands out: This is not a chaseable bullish recommendation. The Phase 3 cancer-vaccine endpoint produced an extreme roughly 83%-100% premarket reaction and active event trading, so it remains only a clinical-breakthrough watch.

Trigger: Reassess only if heavy opening turnover absorbs the gap, volatility contracts into a stable range, and full clinical detail supports the headline.

Risk: A single-event driver, an extreme gap, and incomplete statistical and regulatory detail. Explicitly avoid chasing and wait for stabilization.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative strengthMedical innovation through MRK/MRNA, delivered analog-chip earnings through ADI, beauty recovery through EL, and oil-supported energy cash flow.
Event drivenFOMC minutes, Hormuz shipping developments, details from the MRK/MRNA Phase 3 study, and tonight's BILL, BULL and WOLF results.
Under pressureHigh-multiple AI hardware and memory. Oracle, Marvell, Intel and Micron are weak premarket, while Target's fundamental improvement also lacks positive price feedback.
Validation signalsWhether the 10-year stays below 4.70%, Brent extends higher, ADI/MRK/EL hold gaps, and MRNA suffers violent profit-taking.

Logic Chain

Consecutive declines in AI leaders with the 10-year near 4.70% show that valuation compression, not one company headline, remains the dominant technology variable.
Brent near $91.91 reinforces inflation and high-rate constraints, helping energy cash flow while further pressuring long-duration growth.
ADI, MRK and EL earned positive reactions through earnings or clinical data, shifting capital from broad AI exposure toward verifiable outcomes.
If the minutes are not more hawkish, oil stops rising and positive-reaction names hold their gaps, internal rotation can support the indexes; otherwise Nasdaq may keep lagging.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probabilities

These are subjective probabilities based on known consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions and industry conditions—not facts. Company IR was used to verify timing, and already-reported or incorrectly dated names were excluded.

High · BILL Holdings (BILL) · 65%The company confirmed an Aug. 19 after-close release. Consensus is roughly $0.70-$0.72 in adjusted EPS and about $430 million in revenue. Four straight EPS beats and revenue above expectations in the last three quarters support the higher probability; small-business demand, payment volume and FY27 guidance are the risks.
Medium · Webull (BULL) · 45%A company release confirmed an Aug. 19 after-close report. Expectations are roughly $0.03-$0.05 in EPS and $175-$187 million in revenue. Active trading is supportive, but the last quarter missed on both EPS and revenue and only one of the last three reports beat, keeping the view neutral-to-low.
Low · Wolfspeed (WOLF) · 35%The company confirmed a 5:00 p.m. ET Aug. 19 earnings call. Consensus is roughly -$2.45 in EPS, while revenue estimates vary around $150-$225 million. The latest earnings surprise improved, but negative gross margin, utilization, cash flow and guidance uncertainty keep the beat view low.

Risk Radar

Oil and Hormuz escalation

Brent is already near $91.91. A renewed shipping escalation would lift inflation expectations and long yields, compressing technology valuations.

AI selling broadens

Micron, NVIDIA and Broadcom fell sharply Tuesday, while Oracle, Marvell, Intel and Micron remain weak Wednesday premarket. Deleveraging can spread across sectors.

Extreme MRNA gap reversal

MRNA was up roughly 83%-100% at one point on a single clinical event. Treat it only as a high-volatility watch, avoid chasing, and wait for data detail and price stability.

FOMC minutes reset the rate path

More-hawkish-than-expected minutes could restart the 10-year yield's rise and pressure even the earnings and event winners.
